description: This file contains implementations of functions that generate log parameter dictionaries for cookie events in the Chromium project, specifically related to cookie monitoring and logging.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterConstructorParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with a boolean indicating if a persistent store is used.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieAdded
methods.description: Generates a log dictionary for a cookie addition event, including cookie attributes.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieDeleted
methods.description: Generates a log dictionary for a cookie deletion event, including cookie attributes and cause.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieRejectedSecure
methods.description: Logs details when a secure cookie is rejected.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieRejectedHttponly
methods.description: Logs details when an HttpOnly cookie is rejected.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookiePreservedSkippedSecure
methods.description: Logs details when a secure cookie is skipped and preserved.
